note: develop's own trigger fixture: queries that should invoke develop and near-miss negatives that should not. Used by the light trigger check and, at Publish, the full smoke test. Activation is proven by observing a Skill tool-use event in the run (a brain.command / harness concern), never by a description read alone. This file is the worked example every skill carries; near-misses are genuine adjacents, not obviously irrelevant queries.
